verdicts.reason: A squashes the round NEW badge into a flattened oval, which distorts a brand element. It also shrinks the jar to a small afterthought floating on a centre axis that matches nothing, while the text is left-aligned, so the product hero is lost and the stacking looks arbitrary. B keeps the original structure with the badge round and the jar at hero size, and the hierarchy reads clearly; its only flaws are minor: a little dead space on the right and the CTA sitting slightly tight to the bottom edge.
